laws.rule: In Kopački rit Nature Park (run by the public institution JU PP Kopački rit) visitors may walk only on marked paths and sightseeing areas. The code of conduct bans picking or damaging plants and fungi, disturbing or collecting animals and nests, swimming, unleashed dogs, rubbish, fires, camping, commercial shooting or photography without the park's permission, and any tourism, catering or trade business without a park concession. Boat tours and programmes are by reservation (the park says reservations are mandatory for all programmes). The 2026 price list gives a park entry ticket of EUR 3.00 (about A$4.77, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) and park entry plus a boat tour of up to one hour from Sakadaš at EUR 15.00 for adults (about A$23.84).
